occurrence.title: Initial Activision stake disclosed in Q4 2021 13F
occurrence.subject_relevance: Berkshire's initial ~$1 billion Activision Blizzard purchase preceded Microsoft's announced acquisition and is the background to the later merger-arbitrage position Buffett described; the source does not disclose whether Buffett or his lieutenants made the purchase.

occurrence.title: 2022 annual shareholder letter published
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett's February 2023 shareholder letter advocated operating earnings over GAAP measures and called GAAP earnings '100 percent misleading when viewed quarterly or even annually,' while Berkshire reported its 2022 results.

occurrence.title: 2023 annual meeting Q&A session
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett was the principal speaker at Berkshire's 59th annual meeting, scheduled to answer shareholder questions for about five hours and to oppose shareholder proposals with his 32% voting power.

occurrence.title: Buffett succession statements on Greg Abel
occurrence.subject_relevance: At the 2023 annual meeting Buffett stated that Greg Abel would inherit some of his work, predicted Abel would be more successful than him, and opposed shareholder proposals.

occurrence.title: Annual charitable donation of ~$4.63 billion in Berkshire stock
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett made his annual charitable donation of Berkshire stock worth about $4.63 billion to five institutions, most of it to the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

occurrence.title: Class A conversion and ~$866 million donation to four family charities
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett converted 1,600 Class A shares into 2,400,000 Class B shares and gifted them to four family charities, a total Reuters calculated at about $866 million.

occurrence.title: CalPERS-backed proposal to replace Buffett as chairman was defeated at the 2022 annual meeting
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett was the target of a CalPERS-backed proposal to replace him as Berkshire chairman, which was defeated at the shareholder meeting.

occurrence.title: Berkshire reports 2022 net loss of $22.8 billion and record $30.8 billion operating earnings
occurrence.subject_relevance: Buffett, as Berkshire's chairman and CEO, publicly dismissed the reported 2022 GAAP net loss as misleading and defended operating earnings as the preferred performance measure.

financial_transaction.name: Purchase of Activision Blizzard shares
details: Berkshire spent nearly $1 billion to buy nearly 14.7 million Activision Blizzard shares.
As of 2021-12-31, Berkshire held 14.66 million Activision shares worth $975 million.
The purchase preceded Microsoft's announced $68.7 billion acquisition of Activision by a few weeks.
The source does not disclose whether Buffett or his two investment lieutenants made the purchase.

financial_transaction.name: Annual charitable stock donation
details: Total donation of Berkshire stock worth about $4.63 billion to five institutions
Donated $3.54 billion (76%) to the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
Donated nearly $1 billion in total to four charities run by his three children
More than 10.45 million Class B shares went to the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust, worth nearly $3.54 billion at the $338.61 closing price
1,045,300 shares to the Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation; 731,700 shares to the Sherwood Foundation, Howard G. Buffett Foundation and NoVo Foundation

financial_transaction.name: Charitable gift of Berkshire Hathaway Class B shares
details: Buffett converted 1,600 Class A shares into 2,400,000 Class B shares before gifting them.
1,500,000 Class B shares went to the Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation.
300,000 Class B shares each went to the Sherwood Foundation, the Howard G. Buffett Foundation and the NoVo Foundation.
Reuters calculated the total donation at about $866 million.

Buffett said in the letter that 2022 was a good year for business despite GAAP earnings being $112 billion lower than the previous year.
